FFTRadNet.notes: Per-frame input tensor is 32*512*256 = channels*range*Doppler. 32 channels = real+imag of the 16-Rx range-Doppler spectrum; 512 range bins are code-fixed; the 256 Doppler axis carries the 12*16 MIMO array (192 virtual antennas) that fftradnet.py's hardcoded geometry (NbTxAntenna/NbRxAntenna) expects. RADIal-only; not configurable here.

RODNet_CDC.notes: Fully convolutional; RA map H*W is dataset-determined (CRUW ~128*128). in_channels=2 = real+imag of one map.

RODNet_CDCv2.notes: v2 uses MNet (mnet_cfg=[4,32]); in_channels=4. H*W dataset-determined.

RECORD.notes: Fully convolutional; H*W dataset-determined (CARRADA RD 256*64, RA 256*256). Temporal model (bottleneck LSTM).

RECORDNoLstmMulti.notes: CARRADA path uses in_channels=1 per feature; the CRUW stacked path uses in_channels=96. H*W dataset-determined. CONFIRM which applies to your setup.

MVRECORD.notes: Multi-view: separate RD/RA/AD encoders (in_channels=1 each). H*W dataset-determined.

RADDet.notes: RAD cube: range 256 * azimuth 256 * doppler 64; doppler bins are the channel dim (input_channels=64). Pinned in model config.

DAROD.notes: RD map 256*64, 1 channel (model config input_size=[256,64,1]). Pinned in model config.

TransRAD.notes: RAD cube with the Doppler axis resized 64->256 by nearest neighbour in the adapter and used as the channel axis of a 2D RMT backbone (TransRAD Train.py target_shape [256,256,256]); range and azimuth 256 each. Boxes are 3D [x,y,z,w,h,d] in the original 256x256x64 cube. Pinned in model config; the on-disk Doppler size 64 is in the train config as eval_input_size.

RAMP_CNN.notes: ramap_rsize=128, ramap_asize=128 over a 16-frame window; consumes RD/RA/AD. in_channels is per view and is NOT in the model config - it is hardcoded in each encoder's conv1a (ramp_cnn.py): RA=2 (real+imag), RD=1, AD=1 (magnitude). Input temporal axis is 2*win (=32), not win: each frame yields two temporal samples (RA chirps 0 and 128; RD/AD two overlapping 128-chirp Doppler windows [0:128] and [127:255], because the 128-point Doppler FFT cannot take all 255 chirps at once). Encoder strides depth /8, decoder upsamples x4, net /2, so output depth is win and matches the (3,win,128,128) label. Per-view spatial axes differ (RA range*angle, RD range*velocity, AD angle*velocity) and coincide at 128 only because UWCR uses 128 range/angle/velocity bins; ramap_vsize comes from the dataset radar config, not this file. Inputs are not normalized. The paper (arXiv 2011.08981) states 128x128x128x16 and documents neither the chirp split nor the /2; both match the reference implementation upstream (slice3d.py, dataLoader/CRDatasets.py).

RadarCrossAttention.notes: Cross-attention over RD/RA/AD; no spatial size or in_channels pinned in model config (CONFIRM).

PointPillar.notes: PointPillars baseline on VoD radar (N*7), the slice-3.5 reference at 52.27 mAP entire area. Same code path as RadarPillar with the RadarPillars extras switched off in config. Sensor-agnostic by design: 'lidarPC' becomes valid here once the VoD LiDAR data path lands (spec slice 5).

RadarPillar.notes: PointPillars base of RadarPillars (arXiv:2408.05020) on the VoD radar point cloud (N*7). Pillar grid/anchors pinned in model config; radar accumulation variant (radar/3frames/5frames) in train config.

T_RODNet.notes: 16-frame window of complex (real+imag) RA maps, one chirp per window (random in training, chirp 0 at test, as the reference's CRDataset/test.py), built by TRODNetOnCRUW. Output: RODNet-style per-class confidence maps (3, 16, 128, 128), peak-picked by the RODNet post-processing; scored with the OLS evaluator. The Swin patch embedding fixes the window at 16 frames and the maps at 128x128.
